name: plan-forge-flow
description: A Windows x64-only typed .NET 10 plan hardening, implementation, and independent review workflow for Codex, exposed as an MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Grill, review, build, and verify a plan
interface.longDescription: Turns an idea into a session-scoped plan, reviews it round by round with a fresh critic, implements it task by task with a persistent builder, and finishes with a complete code review. The critic and builder run as separate Claude, Codex, or Cursor processes, so the model doing the judging need not be the model doing the work.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $forge to harden, review, and implement my plan.
